identity.name: Cathedral of Sparks
identity.summary: A miniature copper cathedral with two jagged gold towers.
identity.description: Costs 5 mana per activation. Deals 22 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 5 spark through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: Every bell inside rings once for the same bolt of lightning.

effects.description: Costs 5 mana per activation. Deals 22 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 5 spark through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its lightning trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Black Rain Theorem, Solar Crucible, Storm Abacus, Winter Orrery into Cathedral of Sparks.

visual.brief: A miniature copper cathedral with two jagged gold towers.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A miniature copper cathedral with two jagged gold towers.
